schema.description: The pick-face replenishment move a REPLENISH task executes (ADR-0050), from WorkReleased.data.replenishment. Both bins are always known. `priority` is recorded for the operator's view; claimNext orders by CPT only.

requestId.description: The replenishment request id, published as TaskCompleted.request_ref.

executed.description: The executed move, present once the task is completed.

schema.title: TaskReplenishment
